# ADA repository agent instructions

Before repository changes, fetch and read the persistent off-main ecosystem roadmap:

```bash
git fetch origin agent/ecosystem-roadmap && \
git show origin/agent/ecosystem-roadmap:.agent/ADA_ECOSYSTEM_ROADMAP.yaml
```

Treat root `AGENTS.md` as mandatory bootstrap policy. If the roadmap is unavailable, fail closed for major semantic-adoption, novelty, cross-repository promotion, or merge decisions.

Preserve ADA's evidence-first attention discovery role and keep production execution ownership in FLAT-ATTENTION. Candidate generation or interesting mathematics is never sufficient for adoption.
